build_transformer_decoder: build a TransformerDecoder model with configurable layers, hidden size, heads, and position embeddings
generate_text_from_prompts: generate new tokens from a list of prompt tensors using greedy or sampled decoding
add_args_parser: add transformer decoder arguments like nlayers, hid-sz, nheads, and pos-emb to an ArgumentParser
preprocess_config_defaults: preprocess a config object to set default ff-sz and head-dim values
review_forward_pass: review the TransformerDecoder forward pass that computes log-probabilities over the vocabulary
